cover_headline: Adani Group Unveils $120 Billion Capex Plan Over Five Years
facts: Adani Group plans to invest about $120 billion in capital expenditure over the next five years, more than $20 billion a year, across all group businesses
About 70% of the investments will be in energy, about 20% in transport and logistics and 10% in business adjacencies such as cement, copper and aluminium
The group estimates these investments will help double its asset base to Rs 18 lakh crore and generate core earnings of Rs 2.6 lakh crore to Rs 3 lakh crore in five years

quote.text: Over the next five years, we plan to invest about $120 billion — over $20 billion a year — across all our businesses.
quote.speaker: Pranav Adani

end.headline: Adani Group Unveils $120 Billion Capex Plan Over Five Years
end.line: Executives told Fortune India the group plans more than $20 billion a year across energy, transport and adjacencies.
